verdict.rationale: Firebase documents an official MCP server that works with any MCP client, including Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Cline and Windsurf. It exposes concrete tools for creating and managing projects, managing Auth users, and working with Firestore and SQL Connect data, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in real agent workflows.
